title: Konta fiscal rule set
description: An immutable, effective-dated slice of Moldovan fiscal law. Every value must be traceable to a published act.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. md-2026 or md-2026.2 for an amendment.

effectiveTo.description: Last date this set governs. Null while it is the current set.

publishedOn.description: When WE published this set. Not the same as when it took legal effect: Moldova amends the Fiscal Code mid-year with retroactive effect, and reproducing what a filing looked like when it was filed requires both dates.

status.description: Only 'approved' sets may be used to produce a filing.

approvedBy.description: The licensed accountant or auditor who signed this set off. Required once status is 'approved'.

sources.description: The legal instruments this set encodes.

article.description: Article, point or annex, e.g. 'art. 15 lit. a)'.

verified.description: True only when a human has read the act itself, not a summary of it.

values.description: Namespaced rule values. Keys are lower_snake_case segments joined by dots, e.g. payroll.cnas.employer_rate.

number.description: Numeric value, as a JSON number or a decimal string. Use a string for anything where binary floating point could lose precision.

text.description: Text value, for a code, form identifier or enumeration member.

sourceIndex.description: Index into this set's sources array. A value that cannot be cited does not belong here.

confidence.description: 'verified' means a human read the cited act. Only verified values may appear in an approved set.
